We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (from make_5_lvl2-template_search-3) to the molecule. We have the mapped_rxn and template_id. We need to apply that template to the product molecule? The product is the molecule given earlier? The input from make_5_lvl2-apply_template-2 gave answer: a list of two SMILES: product? Actually that answer is list of two SMILES: ["O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O","F[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C"] That seems to be product and reagent? The mapped_rxn shows product>>reagent? Actually mapped_rxn: "O[Si]...>>F[Si]..." So product is the first SMILES, reagent is second. The template likely transforms product to reagent (retro). So applying template to product should give precursors: maybe the product splits into two fragments: the silicon-containing fragment and something else? The template likely corresponds to DIBAL-H reduction of ester to aldehyde, but here we have silicon groups? Not sure.

But we can just apply the template using apply_template tool with product SMILES and template_id. We have template_id = 12345. Let's call apply_template.
